description:
Upload local pictures to eBay Picture Services and return the EPS image URLs in the same order, ready for product.imageUrls on an inventory item. Uses the Media API (createImageFromFile). Unused images expire after a while; they become permanent once a listing uses them.

Local file access is opt-in: the file must sit inside a directory listed in EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_DIRS (or under EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_ROOT, which also anchors media://<relative-path> references). Symlinks are resolved before the check.

paths.description: Image files in listing order: JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, WEBP, AVIF, or HEIC, up to 12 MB each

items.description: Absolute local path, or media://<relative-path> resolved under EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_ROOT. The file must sit inside EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_DIRS / EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_ROOT

name: ebay_upload_images
